friends.createHint: Opens a waiting room with a code to send your friends

gameType.title: Game type

note.solo: Unrated. The board comes from the puzzles on this phone, without repeating one you played recently.
note.bot: Unrated. The board comes from the puzzles on this phone, without repeating one you played recently. Next, you choose your opponent.
note.ranked: Rated. An opponent near your rating, a board from the server's pool you haven't played, and the same board for both of you.
note.rankedGroup: Rated. Opponents near your rating, a board from the server's pool you haven't played, and the same board for everyone. The game starts when the table is full.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hapticsHint: Short vibrations as feedback for moves
settings.motionHint: Fewer animations: scores jump straight to the result, and an interference shows as a still cover for the same time.
settings.languageHint: Changing the language restarts the app.
settings.testingHint: Test (staging) builds only. The store version does not have it.
settings.chainPenaltyHint: From the next chain stage: a digit in a cell that can’t be known yet costs 5 seconds and is not placed.
settings.unlockAllHint: Every stage is open on the map. Stars and XP count as usual.

languageConfirm.title: Switch the language to {{language}}?
languageConfirm.body: The app restarts, so every screen shows in the new language's direction.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.body: The leaderboard opens together with ranked games.

history.title: History
history.body: All your games will be here, with replays and an explanation for every move. Meanwhile, your latest practices are on the home screen.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.body: Achievements, levels and XP are on their way.

botSelect.title: Choose a bot
botSelect.subtitle: {{mode}} · {{type}}
botSelect.note: That's the time for an ordinary move. A cell that takes harder logic takes the bot longer, and the last gap of a row, column or box a little less. The bot plays the same board, in real time.
botSelect.cardLabel_one: Level {{level}}, {{title}}: {{name}}. {{behavior}}. Thinks {{from}} to {{to}} second a move, {{mistakes}}% mistakes
botSelect.cardLabel_other: Level {{level}}, {{title}}: {{name}}. {{behavior}}. Thinks {{from}} to {{to}} seconds a move, {{mistakes}}% mistakes

1.title: Novice
1.behavior: Slow, makes a fair few mistakes, and lets you learn

2.title: Amateur
2.behavior: Relaxed, slips here and there, and sometimes sends a 😂

3.title: Advanced
3.behavior: Steady and thoughtful, and hard to overtake

4.title: Master
4.behavior: Fast, hardly ever wrong, and a little smug 😎
